basic_info.main_problem: 因纸杯蛋糕生意带来的混乱与脏乱感而感到overwhelmed，认为这种“乱”Undoing了烘焙带来的喜悦，以至考虑放弃生意。
basic_info.core_demands: “我想再次享受烘焙，而not是总被压倒的感觉淹not。”
growth_experiences: 一年前开办纸杯蛋糕生意，起初压力尚可，但随着时间推移，因烘焙过程中的混乱与without序感而愈发Anxiety，每次烘焙都更关注“乱”而忽视乐趣；多次尝试建立组织系统和清洁计划，效果有限。
长期在餐馆工作且工作not yet受影响；与朋友关系因自己反复谈论想退出生意而趋于紧张，同时对过去喜爱的活动（如周末远足）的兴趣下降。

core_beliefs: Success must be built on complete order and control, otherwise it is failure

special_situations.event: 烘焙业务进行中，厨房出现明显的杂乱和失序
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能把厨房保持干净有序，就说明我not适合经营这门生意
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 制定严格的组织系统与清洁时间表，在操作中not断Self-monitoring并加快清理
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我在失败；我not适合做这个生意

special_situations.event: Even when gaining customer praise and a sense of achievement, attention is still focused on the 'mess' after baking
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Negative factors matter more than positive outcomes and must take priority as the basis for decisions
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly weighs negative impacts, downplays positive feedback, considers reducing output or quitting to eliminate the chaos
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些好评并not能说明我做得好，关键是我控制not好现场

special_situations.event: 思考是否退出生意以摆脱压力与混乱
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 当混乱without法被完全控制时，唯一有效的办法就是退出
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 预先设想退出后的轻松与清爽，以此减轻当下Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 只要我一退出，生活就会轻松很多

special_situations.event: When interacting with friends, repeatedly talking about 'should tidy everything up' while avoiding deeper feelings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 我应该把厨房保持一尘not染，才能算合格的经营者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 用“应该/必须”的标准要求自己，避免向他人暴露脆弱与Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我就应该把一切处理好，否则就not配继续做这门生意

core_conflict.wish: Longs to prove their competence and value through a controllable and orderly environment, and to enjoy the satisfaction baking brings again
core_conflict.fear: 害怕陷入混乱与失控从而暴露“not称职/失败”的一面，被他人评判或Self-denial
defense_goal: 通过Reinforcement控制与秩序来降低Anxiety
回避暴露脆弱感受以维持自我价值感的完整
以退出的想法来减轻not堪与羞耻感

object_relations.self_representation: 需要把一切控制妥当才能被视为合格的经营者
object_relations.object_representation: 他人（顾客/外界）像挑剔的评判者，随时会因我的失序而negate我

object_relations.self_representation: 在混乱面前容易失控、可能失败的人
object_relations.object_representation: 朋友会被我的问题拖累或厌烦的他者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about or facing the chaos and disorder at the baking site, and when asked about deeper feelings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将“混乱=失败/会被negate”内化为核心框架，倾向以理性分析和方案讨论来取代情绪暴露
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responds in an analytical, problem-solving-oriented tone, focusing on processes and organizational strategies, reducing emotion words and self-exposure.

manifestations: Repeatedly torn between the choice of whether to withdraw from the business and responsibility, with a sense of constraint by the self-rule of 'must completely control'
outcomes: 通过退出设想来逃避not适与责任带来的压力

manifestations: Living alone；很少与朋友深入分享真实感受，仅反复抱怨想退出
outcomes: 在压力时缺乏连接与被理解的体验，加重Anxiety

manifestations: 烘焙曾带来喜悦与成就，但被“混乱/失序”的体验not断吞not
outcomes: 对业务热情减退并考虑放弃

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 以“我应该/必须把厨房保持一尘not染”自我要求来定义合格与否
将整洁度等同于成功与价值感

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: In interactions with others, repeatedly emphasizes wanting to quit, avoiding expressing vulnerability and needs
Highly vigilant about chaos and self-blaming, constantly judging whether he is 'good enough'

exception_events.target_problem: 在烘焙业务场景中，一看到厨房杂乱常会被压倒性Anxiety占据，进而忽视成就与乐趣并反复考虑退出。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在收到顾客的积极评价、看到他人享用蛋糕的时刻，Li Ming并not yet像往常那样只盯着混乱，而是体验到成就与喜悦，注意到自己作品的价值。
exception_events.reason: Clue: positive feedback from outside turned the attention from 'mess' to the value of the product; at these moments his attention focused more on the customer experience and outcomes, thereby weakening the excessive attention to disorder.

顾客的正向评价与反馈频现
愿意尝试组织系统与清洁计划、具备行动力
能够识do not思维偏差并愿意进行行为实验
有一定的社会支持资源（有几位亲密朋友）

心理过滤与negate积极使成就感被“乱”掩盖

target_behavior.behavior: 在烘焙时因混乱而出现的强烈Anxiety与退出冲动
antecedent: 开始烘焙并看到厨房杂乱或流程失序
清洁not yet能即时完成、物品摆放not整齐

target_behavior.function: 逃避not适与Anxiety、迅速恢复可控与安全感
target_behavior.consequence: 烘焙乐趣显著下降，反复考虑退出，兴趣活动减少，对Interpersonal relationships与日常生活造成负面影响

target_behavior.behavior: In interactions with friends, repeatedly complains about wanting to quit while avoiding expressing true needs and emotions

回想工作中的混乱经历
